name: Better Cores
description: The tunnel cores of the panel at a glance (which are installed and running, the last release of each project) and the WARP engine other plugins build on: an AmneziaWG client in the plugin that checks a Cloudflare WARP account and endpoint through a real tunnel and scans Cloudflare's endpoints for the quickest. The plugins that build on it (Better WARP, Better OpenFlux, Better olcRTC) require it.
author: AllIsA1
